blocks.text: The module documentation defines the token convention, price-source precedence, unknown-model default, cached-read behavior, and the guarantee that malformed inputs or configuration failures never block a call.
blocks.title: Pricing contract and fail-open rules

blocks.text: ModelPrices stores three per-million prices and whether they are known. Helpers log at most once, coerce token counts to safe integers, and accept only finite non-negative numeric prices.
blocks.title: Price and input normalization

blocks.text: _config reads credits.json, validates defaults, filters model entries, and falls back to built-in conservative prices on any file-level failure. reload_config clears both the config cache and warning memory; the shared llm table is imported lazily.
blocks.title: Configuration loading

blocks.text: prices_for combines the shared input/output table with JSON cached pricing, warns once for missing cached prices or unknown models, and returns a conservative default when no usable model price exists.
blocks.title: Selecting model prices

blocks.anchor: def _usd(provider, model, input, cached_input, output) -> float:
blocks.text: _usd applies uncached, cached, and output prices per million tokens. cost_usd_for rounds the result and fails open; credits_for multiplies by the configured credit rate and returns zero when that rate or calculation is unusable.
blocks.title: Cost and credit calculations

purpose: This module combines the shared model price table with cached-read prices from credits.json and the global credits-per-dollar plan setting. It cleans malformed measurements, falls back conservatively for unknown models or broken configuration, and never lets metering failures block a call.
